urdu.name: خدیجہ
urdu.long_meaning: Khady (خدیجہ) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم خدیجہ، زوجہ نبی ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

arabic.long_meaning: Khady (خَدِيجَة) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي خَدِيجَة، زَوْجَةُ النَّبِيّ. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

faq.a: Khady is associated with the Arabic form خَدِيجَة, whose core sense is khady; khadija (wolof form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Khady?
faq.a: Khady is associated with Arabic. Khady is the Wolof (Senegalese) form of Arabic خَدِيجَة (Khadīja), the name of the Prophet's first wife.
Yes — the underlying form خَدِيجَة is Arabic.
Khady can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Khady should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Khadīja is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Khady mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Khady is rendered خدیجہ and carries the sense خدیجہ، زوجہ نبی.

faq.q: What does Khady mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Khady is rendered خدیجه and carries the sense خدیجه، نام همسر پیامبر.
A romanized syllable approximation is kha-dy. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Khady?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Khady, khady. Script forms are خديجه, خدیجه, خدیجہ, خَدِيجَة, ख़ादी.

faq.q: Is Khady a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
